evidence.finding: Documents Python CLI, dashboard, VS Code launcher, three agent backends, per-turn commits and opt-in Git transcript sharing. Documentation is not execution evidence.

evidence.title: aGiTrack LICENSE
evidence.finding: Apache-2.0 terms apply to the public repository.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/cli.py
evidence.finding: CLI starts interactive/background sessions, dashboard, JSON bridge, sharing, recovery, status, stop and redaction. Bounded inspection of the complete parser does not expose an issue, epic, scheduler, MCP-server or webhook command family.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/backends/__init__.py
evidence.finding: The complete registered headless backend set is ClaudeBackend, CodexBackend and OpenCodeBackend; these launch external coding agents.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/config/settings.py
evidence.finding: Configuration persists global and repository preferences, backend command, sandbox/write carve-outs, summary model, update checks and sharing limits. It contains no vendor credit ledger or native account brokerage.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/config/state.py
evidence.locator: AgitrackState persistence and session state; bounded issue/epic/requirements search across agitrack/
evidence.finding: Local JSON state tracks repository and backend sessions. The runtime module inventory and searches for issue, epic, dependency, backlog and requirement found no native durable issue or product-spec entity. Issue mentions in comments refer to the project development tracker.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/proxy/session.py
evidence.finding: Session owns backend process and per-session transcript, parse, commit, summary, status and input state; runner can keep background sessions while switching the foreground session.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/git/lock.py
evidence.finding: OS file lock admits one aGiTrack owner per repository. This is writer exclusion between processes, not a one-session limit inside the process and not a human/agent issue ownership system.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/sessions/store.py
evidence.finding: Git custom ref stores latest session snapshots. Contributor IDs retain lineage. Claude row IDs support union merging; Codex/OpenCode fall back when rows cannot be line-merged. Default keeps five recent shared sessions per contributor.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/proxy/sharing.py
evidence.finding: Manual share asks consent, redacts and bounds the transcript, and publishes through Git; resume imports a backend transcript into a local session rather than transferring the remote live process.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/proxy/sandbox.py
evidence.finding: macOS sandbox-exec and Linux bubblewrap restrict writes to the base and sibling worktrees, with .git, active worktree and configured writable exceptions. Linux mirrors the host filesystem; no network namespace is created. Windows lacks this write-confinement backend.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/shell/bridge.py
evidence.finding: Local newline-delimited JSON bridge accepts prompt, command, answer and exit; emits replies, commit IDs, notices and decisions. It is not JSON-RPC or MCP and has no separate network authentication.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/shell/runner.py
evidence.finding: Command dispatch offers status, backend switching, commits, staging and summarizer controls; prompts execute through configured external backend. No native issue hierarchy, formal review queue or spec gate is dispatched.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/metrics/pricing.py
evidence.locator: Rates; _lookup; module contract and pricing functions
evidence.finding: Dashboard cost uses recorded tokens and a bundled dated provider price table; it is an indicative API-price estimate, not billing. Unknown/local prices are unavailable rather than zero; subagent tokens use the recorded parent-turn model.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/metrics/web.py
evidence.finding: Dashboard aggregates commit/agent/model/time activity, searches interaction traces and displays exact-commit diffs. Its models are commits and transcripts rather than native issues, review approvals or epic dependencies.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/proxy/crash.py
evidence.finding: Crash and stall diagnostics are written locally under .agitrack; five crash reports and 200 stall lines are retained. This module does not upload diagnostics.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/update/updater.py
evidence.finding: Update checks call Git/PyPI/GitHub and can download releases. Bounded analytics/telemetry/PostHog/Segment/Sentry/crash-report searches of agitrack and editors/vscode found local diagnostics and functional update requests, not an ADE usage/crash-upload client. This does not establish external provider practices.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/git/repo.py
evidence.locator: GitRepo commit, diff, merge, branch and custom-ref operations
evidence.finding: Product code owns Git commits, diff inspection and branch integration. Git object IDs link traces to changes; ordinary Git history remains mutable by its owner.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/recovery.py
evidence.finding: Recovery repairs tracking from repository and transcript state. No remote compute reconstruction service or migration of a running process is provided.

evidence.title: aGiTrack editors/vscode/src/extension.ts
evidence.finding: The extension launches the real CLI in an integrated terminal and shows a VS Code progress notification while preparing the terminal. This is a startup notification, not a background task-completion push service.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/metrics/web.py
evidence.locator: viewport line1419; max-width760px CSS lines1643–1665 and1775; dashboard filters/commit diff views
evidence.finding: The dashboard sets a device-width viewport and rearranges filter controls and split/row layouts at phone widths. This establishes responsive inspection UI, not tested touch usability or CLI task-control parity.

evidence.title: aGiTrack review-release
evidence.finding: GitHub identifies release v0.6.36 published on2026-11-26; this release receipt is separate from the inspected default-branch commit.

evidence.title: aGiTrack SECURITY.md
evidence.finding: The repository security policy documents the supported/reporting scope. It is documentation, not an audited assurance report.

evidence.title: aGiTrack agitrack/proxy/runner.py
evidence.finding: The interactive launch calls OS confinement when a distinct worktree, sandbox option and usable platform mechanism exist.
